scripts-info.dev: Starts the game in the browser while developing (Vite, reloads on save).
scripts-info.build: Type-checks, then builds the game for release into dist/.
scripts-info.preview: Serves the built game from dist/, to try it as released.
scripts-info.bots: Bots playtest: 100 bots, 1 game hour each, on random seeds, quiet; report in tests/bots/reports/. Fails if anything went wrong.
scripts-info.bots:quick: Bots playtest, short: 10 bots, 10 game minutes each, quiet.
scripts-info.bots:verbose: As bots, but showing what every bot is up to, live.
scripts-info.bots:quick:verbose: As bots:quick, but showing what every bot is up to, live.
scripts-info.bots:small: 4 bots, 1 game hour each, shown live.
scripts-info.bots:long: 6 bots, 8 game hours each, shown live.
scripts-info.(settings): Any bots script takes: BOTS=n (how many), BOT_MINUTES=n (game minutes each), BOT_SEEDS=a,b (play those games again, exactly), BOT_FIRST_SEED=n (seeds n, n+1…), BOT_VERBOSE=1 (live), e.g. BOT_SEEDS=123 npm run bots:verbose.
